content.query:
select 'SELECT * INTO BUSC.'+TABLE_NAME+'_BU_20240405 FROM BUSC.'+TABLE_NAME from information_schema.tables
where table_schema = 'BUSC'
and table_name like 'DEP%'
and table_name not like '%2023%'
and table_name not like '%2024%'
and table_name not like '%TEST%'
and table_name not like '%BACKUP%'
and table_name not like '%DELETE%'
and table_name not like '%DELTA%'
